D.comparison: Institution X course using mostly locally created clicker questions and preflights

O.outcome_detail: CURrENT Q3 understanding of electric field and current-density divergence

cells.quote: The CURrENT was given in SP12 at CU (N=24), and also at a small, selective engineering college (“X”; N=11).
cells.note: The study reports that average CU SP12 scores were significantly higher for Q3 than Institution X (p ≤ 0.001). It further states: "However, 10/11 X-students incorrectly thought ∇⋅J would be non-zero inside the wire (the remaining student left this question blank), because the magnitude of J is increasing to the right."
